policy.selection_rule: minimum mean forwards among policies no worse than full hard by 0.5 token pp and 1.0 all-token-example pp; otherwise minimum-forward lexicographic fallback
policy.threshold_semantics: escalate from K3 to K7 when core plurality agreement is strictly below threshold

caveats: v2.1.2 TEST contains exact prompt-and-answer repetitions from v2.1.2 TRAIN; this does not leak into the seven v2.2-trained adapters, but prevents a template-independent holdout claim.
The official project previously evaluated a different selected D_greedy dense model on v2.1.2 TEST; the split is therefore not globally untouched.
cross_v212.claim_boundary: Fixed-method cross-corpus transfer only; not globally untouched or template-independent holdout evidence; do not aggregate with v2.2.
